title: The proven tau-lower bound IS the s=1 vacuity wall: tau(r)>=rho-1/n meets the off-range tau=1 collapse
evidence: Exact-arithmetic probe scripts/probes/_407_conn/probe_C055_vacuity.py (Fraction arithmetic) confirms BOTH arithmetic claims of C055. (1) Consumer feasibility: subspaceDesign_list_card_le (SubspaceDesignListSize.lean:45-51) needs hbig: tau(r)*n + r*n < (r+1)*a with a<=n forced. With the FRS profile from frs_is_subspaceDesign_gk16 (SubspaceDesign.lean:719-727) tau(r)=(k-1)/n on [s]={1..s}, tau(r)=1 off [s]. At s=1 (plain RS, block alphabet F^1), every working rank r>=2 is OFF-range, tau(r)=1, so hbig becomes n+r*n=(r+1)*n < (r+1)*a <=> n<a, contradicting a<=n. Probe shows ALL s=1,r>=2 rows UNSAT across (k,n) in {(2,8),(4,16),(8,32),(16,64),(33,64),(4,8),(2,4)}; all s=1,r=1 rows feasible. (2) Schubert-denominator coincidence: [s]-range membership (1<=r<=s) coincides exactly with (s-r+1)>0 for all tested (s,r) up to s=8 -> the off-[s] tau=1 collapse IS the (s-r+1)<=0 BCDZ25 denominator sign flip. Both cited consumer lemmas are PROVEN axiom-clean in-tree (no sorry/admit/native_decide in SubspaceDesignListSize.lean; the 5 hits in SubspaceDesign.lean are docstring prose 'admitted'/'sorry-free' only). subspaceDesign_tau_lower (lines 171-306) gives tau>=rho-1/n via Singleton bound over the block alphabet; the dichotomy 'two proven theorems whose ranges fail to overlap at s=1' is therefore genuinely machine-checked. The attack_plan lemma subspaceDesign_listsize_vacuous_at_s_one is a trivial wrapper (the n<a contradiction is one line); not landed but its arithmetic is fully verified.
honest_note: The PROVEN part is the in-tree arithmetic DICHOTOMY: the subspace-design list-decoding consumer is genuinely vacuous for plain RS (s=1) at every working rank r>=2, and the [s]-cutoff equals the Schubert denominator sign flip. What is NOT shown -- and what keeps this from being a prize advance -- is any engagement with the prize CORE. C055's own walls are W-subspace and W-genericity: it explains why the Guruswami-Xing/GK16 subspace-design technique CANNOT reach the prize for plain RS (alphabet F^1 forces tau=1 above rank 1), i.e. it documents a structural dead-end, it does not reduce or close the BGK sqrt-cancellation / generalized-Paley-eigenvalue core that actually gates the $1M prize (that core lives in Hab25JohnsonPackageSupply / incomplete-character-sums per the cone guide, untouched here). The vacuity is combinatorial (Singleton-bound block-alphabet ceiling), orthogonal to the analytic prize regime; no proper-subgroup mu_n / large-prime test is even relevant since the mechanism never reaches char-sum cancellation. So: arithmetic claim PROVEN, 'insight toward prize' framing is honestly a wall-explanation, not progress.
